reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gates goal completion and turn termination on successful workspace verification commands, primarily providing automated testing-based completion checks for agents.

summaries.zh: 该插件在智能体结束目标或回合前运行配置或自动检测的验证命令，并在验证失败时阻止完成。
summaries.en: This plugin runs configured or auto-detected workspace verification commands before an agent completes a goal or turn and blocks completion when verification fails.

capabilities: Intercepts goal-completion actions in DeepSeek Harness
Runs configured or auto-detected test and verification commands in the session workspace
Rejects goal completion and can trigger continued agent work when verification fails
Feeds command failures, exit codes, and output tails back to the agent
